title: TIZI x GUYDEEZ = A LOT OF FUN
text:
Tizi is the man of the town. 
He knows all the good spots of Barcelona. 
He knows the cultural things, the historical things, the architectural things, and the gossips. 
He speaks so many languages, the guy is the babel tower himself. 
We had a really good moment with the brother Tizi. 

A Massive thanks to GUYDEEZ for making this afternoon happening - you guys are legend and I cannot see myself discovering a new town without asking for your services. 

All the best guys, 

Thib
author: Thibcrablalou

title: Amazing tour in Barcelona
text:
Perfectly organized by Guydeez, our guide Tizi was fantastic and knew everything about Barcelona, especially the hidden spots. We were able to feel the local atmosphere, which is all we wanted.

I 100% recommend Guydeez and Tizi for Barna.
author: hippolyten478
